submitted.rationale: EQE at the measured points: 0.24% at Sb 0.19, 1.15% at 0.32, 1.50% at 0.38, 0.22% at 0.64 and 0.05% at 0.80. Activity peaks in the Ni-rich/mid region, near Sb≈0.35–0.45. The XRD pattern at 0.32 is a single phase, rutile-like (Q 1.876, 2.374, 2.649, 3.557). At 0.64 the same phase is present plus extra peaks (2.455, 3.651), which suggest a secondary Sb-oxide phase that coincides with the loss of activity. Index 11 (Sb 0.379) gave the highest EQE measured.
